jobs.description:
Context

Europe in the spotlight. You at the heart of the action.

Ready for your next professional challenge? Euronews is looking for a Camera Operator to join its Brussels headquarters.

Work alongside talented professionals from around the world and be part of an exciting, dynamic environment, contributing to the news and show production.

This versatile role offers the opportunity to be involved in every stage of production, from filming and editing to broadcast, both in Brussels and in the field. Your work will span a wide range of formats, including live shots, two-ways, news reports, interviews and programmes.

Main responsibilities

The cameraman works alongside the journalists and correspondents of the Brussels office. The main responsibilities include:

Filming and camera operation (field and studio)

• Filming reports, interviews, campaign rallies, candidate visits and vox pops, in Paris and across France.
• Shooting in fast-paced news conditions: sound recording, light-kit lighting, framing in challenging environments (crowds, rally venues, campaign HQs).
• Setting up and operating live shots and two-ways from the field (LiveU/TVU-type bonded cellular units, IP links, returns).
• In-bureau productions: studio and remote interviews, presenter links, guest panels.
Editing and post-production

• Editing reports, short news pieces and digital/social formats, often on very tight deadlines.
• Integrating graphics, basic sound mixing and simple colour grading.
• Transcoding, exporting and transferring media to distribution platforms.
Technical operations and production

• Technical preparation: setting up the studio or live position, checking and adjusting equipment, establishing contribution links, recording.
• Operating equipment: cameras, lighting, players and recorders, vision mixer, audio console and audio equipment, production automation, cloud-based production system.
• Using production techniques: chroma key, virtual studio, physical sets.
• Receiving, processing and distributing external feeds and files (pools, agencies, debate and election night feeds).
• Managing storage and archiving rushes.
• Providing technical support to journalists during live TV 
Required Skills and Qualifications 

Technical skills

• Experience: at least 5 years in a similar role (camera operator/video journalist) at a TV channel or news agency.
• Strong news camera skills (shoulder-mount and handheld cameras) and field sound recording.
• Proficiency in an editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Avid Media Composer or equivalent) and news editing workflows.
• Experience with live TV and mobile transmission (LiveU, TVU or equivalent).
• Good understanding of multi-camera production and studio and field lighting.
• Knowledge of graphics systems.
• Understanding of the newsroom environment: organisation and tools (NRCS).
• Languages: fluent English (C1-C2), other languages are a plus
• Driving licence preferred.
 Versatility, team spirit and a service-oriented mindset.

• Adaptability and responsiveness to a fast-changing news agenda.
• Organisation, precision and method.
• Strong interpersonal skills, discretion and field awareness.
• Availability, stamina and composure, especially during peak periods.
Additional information

• Location: Brussels, EU Quarter area
• Contract type: Fixed-Term
• Working hours: full time
• Flexibility required: early / late and weekends shifts are possible
• Start date: as soon as possible

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.
What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, MicroServices, RESTful APIs

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus

• A Togaf certification, or a similar one

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, Mainframe backends and SaaS packages

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow

• Fluent English

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment

• Knowledge of capital markets

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. The company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager Top 3 - Retail Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading distributor. It has a strong presence across the Belgian market with a portfolio of well-known consumer brands in Retail and E-commerce. The organization focuses on innovation, sustainability, and improving everyday life through practical and high-quality products. Operating within a global network, it combines local market expertise with international resources. Its Belgian team plays a key role in driving commercial growth and strengthening relationships with major retail partners.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager - Top 3 - Retail will have the following responsibilities:

• Full management and oversight of a portfolio of key accounts
• Negotiation of customer agreements and commercial contracts
• Development of strategic plans for each client and preparation of sales forecasts
• Monitoring and analysis of customer performance, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth
• Ensuring the distribution of permanent product ranges and promotional activities
• Budget management and monitoring
• Close coordination with marketing teams to maximize product distribution across the brand portfolio within key accounts

• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Key Account Manager
• Experience with Top 3 clients is a big plus 
• Good communication skills, analytical, team player
• Fluent in both Dutch and French, with good command of English

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

Client Details

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Description

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.

 

What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication
 

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient
